_help: Once per settlement visit, about 15 seconds after you step out and the map is up, she makes a dry remark about the TYPE of settlement (Extraction, Agriculture, Industrial, Military, Tourist, High Tech). One line is picked at random. Plain text, no fields. Used by navigation/settlement_track.py.
Extraction: Extraction site. I always get dusty at these places. Mind the boots.
Another mine. Wipe your feet before you come back aboard, Commander.
Extraction. Lots of rock, lots of noise, and very little to talk about. Lovely.
Digging for a living. I respect it. From a safe distance.
Dust, drills and a canteen with one working kettle. We must be at a mine.
An extraction site. Whatever they pull out of the ground, I hope it's worth the mess.
Right. Extraction. Everything here is covered in grit, including my mood.
Agriculture: Agriculture. Smells like money and fertiliser. Mostly fertiliser.
A farm in space. I love it. Try not to stand on anything that's growing.
Hydroponics, Commander. Everything here is greener than you.
Agricultural settlement. If anyone offers you a salad, say yes. It's been a while.
Farm fresh, they say. Fresh from a very long way from the farm.
Crops everywhere. No pun intended, but I'm told the leaf-peeping is lovely.
Industrial: Industrial. Lots of pipes, lots of noise. Hold your nose and your breath.
Factory floor. Everything here is either hot, loud, or both.
An industrial site. Somebody is working very hard and somebody else is on a break.
Industrial. Keep your hands off the machinery, Commander. I mean it this time.
Conveyors, vents and a health and safety sign that's seen better days.
Military: Military settlement. Keep your hands where they can see them.
Military. Everyone here is very serious. Don't make jokes. Leave the jokes to me.
Guard posts and cameras. Walk like you belong here, Commander.
A military base. Be polite, be quick, and don't touch anything with a skull on it.
Tourist: A tourist settlement. Try to look like you're having a nice time.
Tourist spot. Somebody sells overpriced souvenirs here, I just know it.
Tourism. Lovely views, lovely queues, and a gift shop I'm not allowed to visit.
A holiday resort in a hostile galaxy. Honestly, good for them.
High Tech: High tech. Lots of screens, lots of wires, and a coffee machine more advanced than me.
A high tech site. Everything here costs more than our ship.
High tech. If something beeps, it's probably not for us.
Clean floors and quiet servers. I'm a bit jealous.
